PR/MR 已关闭且未合并。: The PR/MR was closed without being merged.
PR/MR 已创建，等待合并。: The PR/MR is open and waiting to be merged.
PR/MR 已合并到目标分支。: The PR/MR was merged into the target branch.
为保护现有 Git 状态，已有暂存内容、分支未同步、冲突、敏感文件或确认后发生变: To protect the existing Git state, publishing stops for staged content, an unsynchronized branch, conflicts, sensitive files, or changes made after review.
仓库连接或写入权限尚未就绪。: The repository connection or write permission is not ready.
先打开完整文件清单；确认后才会提交并推送: Open the complete file list first; committing and pushing happen only after confirmation
内容已推送到远端仓库。: The content was pushed to the remote repository.
单篇发布、本地保存、预览分支和仅文章批次保留为次级操作。: Single-article publishing, local save, preview branches, and article-only batches remain secondary actions.
发布前检查未通过。: The pre-publish checks did not pass.
发布流程已打开；默认审阅并推送仓库全部文件，单篇发布、本地保存和预览分支在“其他: The publishing flow is open. Reviewing and pushing every repository file is now the default; single-article publishing, local save, and preview branches are under Other Publishing Options.
只推送草稿分支，不代表生产站点已部署。: Only the draft branch is pushed; this does not mean the production site is deployed.
可以推送，但无法把部署检查当成生产页面证明：%@: Publishing can continue, but deployment checks cannot verify the production page: %@
将草稿同步到远端分支: Sync the draft to the remote branch
已推送或合并，等待部署提交与页面验证。: The content was pushed or merged; waiting for the deployed commit and page verification.
当前扫描检测到 %d 个变更；确认页会重新完整扫描。: The current scan found %d changes; the confirmation page will run a fresh complete scan.
打开代码仓库设置，配置本地仓库与远端目标: Open repository settings to configure the local repository and remote target
打开确认页时会完整扫描所有未忽略变更。: Opening the confirmation page scans every non-ignored change.
把文章文件写入远端仓库。: Write the article files to the remote repository.
推送、合并、部署验证分别显示，线上可达不等于发布完成。: Push, merge, and deployment verification are shown separately. A reachable site does not by itself prove publishing is complete.
检查仓库、权限与文章内容。: Check the repository, permissions, and article content.
正在准备当前文章的远端发布预览…: Preparing the remote publishing preview for the current article…
目标分支已写入提交。: A commit was written to the target branch.
目标分支直接提交，不经过 PR/MR。: Commit directly to the target branch without a PR/MR.
等待 PR/MR 创建或合并。: Waiting for the PR/MR to be created or merged.
这是单篇与仅文章批次的辅助摘要；默认的全文件发布以 Git 工作区确认页为准。: This is an auxiliary summary for single-article and article-only publishing. The Git worktree confirmation is authoritative for the default all-files publish.
这里只显示当前文章；默认全文件发布会在确认页显示整个 Git 工作区。: Only the current article is shown here. The default all-files publish shows the entire Git worktree on its confirmation page.
部署后核对提交归因和线上页面。: After deployment, verify commit attribution and the live page.
部署提交已匹配，生产页面验证完成。: The deployed commit matches and the production page is verified.
默认发布会审阅当前 Git 工作区的全部待提交文件，包括文章、图片、主题、配置、: The default publish reviews every pending Git worktree file, including articles, images, themes, configuration, scripts, and deletions. Confirmation creates one commit and pushes it to the target branch.
